title: Tailwise Plus Multiplier on Freight Service-Failure Refunds - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
For the service-failure refund on a Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase shipped by Large Item Freight Delivery, the freight fee multiplied by the service-failure share is then multiplied by the member multiplier before rounding. The multiplier is read from the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership: its tier, its status and the membership fees charged on its ledger.

| Tier | Status | Membership fee charged within the last 12 months | Member multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | Active or pending downgrade | Yes | 2 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Monthly | Active or pending downgrade | Yes | 1.5 |
| Any tier, status or fee history not shown above | - | - | 1 |

**Each part of the condition is required.** A Tailwise Plus Premier Annual tier in status past due, or one with no membership fee charged within the last 12 months, takes 1. A Pals Rewards Member, Insider or VIP tier takes 1. A customer with no membership takes 1.

**Within the last 12 months.** A membership fee charge counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from today.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A freight fee of $79.00 and a summed service-failure share of 30% give $23.70. For an active Tailwise Plus Annual member with a membership fee charged 4 months ago, $23.70 times 1.5 is $35.55, rounded once at the end. For an active Tailwise Plus Premier Annual member with a fee charged 2 months ago, it is $47.40.
